settings.title: Choose your collection
settings.text: Name six fragrances you’d like to meet, or share your favourite notes and let our boutique curate your set.

settings.title: Discover them on skin
settings.text: Each 3ml vial gives you the opportunity to experience the fragrance and how it develops throughout the day.

settings.title: Find the one that feels like you
settings.text: Explore independent houses, revisit your favourites and take your time before choosing a full bottle.

settings.heading: A little more about your set

settings.question: What is included?
settings.answer: Your Custom Discovery Set contains six 3ml perfume samples. The fragrances are personalised to your choices or curated around your preferences.

settings.question: Can I choose all six fragrances?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose “I’ll choose my six” and pick each fragrance above. Your choices are saved with your order.

settings.question: What if I’m not sure what to choose?
settings.answer: Choose “Curate for me” and share the notes, brands or scent styles you enjoy. Our boutique will build a selection tailored to your taste.

settings.question: Does the set always contain the same fragrances?
settings.answer: No. This is a custom discovery set, rather than a fixed selection. The fragrances depend on your choices and the preferences you share.
